concerns.text: Ensure document generation streaming timeout handling conforms cleanly under concurrent load spikes exceeding 2000ms.
Consider verifying WCAG 2.1 AA focus visible rings across dark-mode and high-contrast browser profiles in addition to the standard theme.
Ensure OpenAPI schema components for DOCX streaming responses maintain explicit binary format specifiers across all tooling generators.
Validate that PIN token rotation and 401 challenge header schemes are covered for token expiration edge cases.
Ensure RAG prompt templates avoid leaking internal file metadata in grounding citation snippets.
